migration_notes.add_audit_log_forensic_columns: Run before enforce_audit_log_immutability; it needs UPDATE on audit_log to seed the hash chain.
migration_notes.enforce_audit_log_immutability: Run last and run as the postgres OS user. It moves audit_log and ai_audit_log ownership to postgres and leaves the application role with SELECT and INSERT only.
migration_notes.backfill_privacy_alias_vault: Needed because ai_privacy_fail_closed defaults to on. Cases ingested before 3.409.0 have no alias vault.
